exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /filter datastar(Filter(ctx, signals))" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /filter datastar(Update(ctx, signals))" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
{{- define "DELETE /filter datastar(Clear(ctx, signals))" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Filter struct {
	Query string `json:"query"`
	Limit int    `json:"limit"`
}

// Server binds a filter form to Datastar signals: GET and DELETE carry the
// signals JSON in the datastar query parameter, POST carries a JSON body,
// and absent signals leave the parameter zero-valued.
type Server struct{}

func format(f Filter) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", f.Query, f.Limit) }

func (Server) Filter(_ context.Context, f Filter) (string, error) { return "get " + format(f), nil }

func (Server) Update(_ context.Context, f Filter) (string, error) { return "post " + format(f), nil }

func (Server) Clear(_ context.Context, f Filter) (string, error) { return "delete " + format(f), nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("GET reads the datastar query parameter", func(t *testing.T) {
		target := "/filter?datastar=" + url.QueryEscape(`{"query":"go","limit":3}`)
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, target, nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "<p>get go:3</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("DELETE reads the datastar query parameter", func(t *testing.T) {
		target := "/filter?datastar=" + url.QueryEscape(`{"query":"x","limit":1}`)
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodDelete, target, nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "<p>delete x:1</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("POST reads the JSON body", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/filter", strings.NewReader(`{"query":"rust","limit":9}`))
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "<p>post rust:9</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("absent signals leave the parameter zero-valued", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/filter", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if want := "<p>get :0</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("malformed JSON is 400", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/filter", strings.NewReader(`{"query":`))
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
	})

	t.Run("duplicate keys take the last value under encoding/json v1", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/filter", strings.NewReader(`{"query":"a","query":"b"}`))
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "<p>post b:0</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})
}
